verdict.rationale: Google Voice ring groups let several people in an organization answer calls from one shared number. Authorized users can also place outbound calls from the ring group's numbers, and round-robin distribution is documented. The evidence never mentions presence status, conversation assignment to a teammate, or internal threads or notes on shared conversations. missing for 10: presence indicators, conversation assignment/ownership, internal team threads/comments, independent or hands-on corroboration of shared-number team use.

support.subject: As a support leader, several teammates share one number with presence, conversation assignment, and internal threads

citations.quote: You can set up ring groups to let people in your organization answer calls from the same Google Voice number.
Under Outbound callers, authorized users can place outbound calls using numbers assigned to the ring group.
Round robin—Rings each member in random order until someone answers.
